title: Research: Lisbon in December - weather and packing
text: Average December highs in Lisbon are about 15 C (59 F) with lows near 9 C (48 F). Rain is common, with roughly 13 wet days. Recommended: waterproof jacket, comfortable walking shoes with grip for wet cobblestones, a warm layer. Sunset is around 17:30.

title: Research: Lisbon neighborhoods compared
text: Alfama: historic, hilly, atmospheric, fado venues; stairs and noise. Baixa: central and flat, easier transit, busier. Principe Real: boutique and calm. For a first winter visit, Alfama is most characterful, Baixa most convenient.

title: Research: California contractor checklist
text: Verify the contractor's CSLB license (class B or C-33 for painting; cabinets typically under B). Home improvement contracts: down payment cannot exceed 10% of the contract price or $1,000, whichever is less. Get a written payment schedule, permits handled by the contractor, and lien releases.

title: Research: Half marathon taper and fueling
text: Taper over 2 weeks: cut mileage 20-30% in week one and about 40-50% in the race week, keep a couple of short tempo efforts. Carbs 7-10 g/kg the 2 days before. Gel every 40-45 minutes starting around mile 4.
